turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Proclamation. Gabayan mo ang lahat ng kalahok sa paglilitis, ang depensa, ang prosekyusyon, ang bawat testigo at ang bawat senador hukom. Pagkalooban mo kami ng lakas, katatagan, at integridad upang maisagawa namin ang aming kanya-kanyang tungkulin ng may dangal at pananagutan. Patawarin mo kami sa aming pagkukulang at pagkakasala. Patuloy mo kami ang akayin sa landas ng katarungan at kabutihan para sa aming bayan. Magpadala po kayo ng maraming anghel ng katotohanan at ilayo sa amin ang pagpapakalat ng kasinungalingan. Ito ang aming dalangin sa ngalan ni Jesus. Amen.

turns.text: Wamil was a state auditor of the Commission on Audit, Intelligence, and Confidential Funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number two, dat siya po ang nag-conduct ng audit ng Office of the Vice President liquidation of confidential expenditures for the periods covering the fourth quarter of 2022, which is December 21 to 31, 2022, and the first, second, and third quarters of 2020. 23. Pangatlo, na si Mr. Wamil po ang nag-conduct ng audit of the Department of Education liquidation of confidential expenditures for the periods covering the first, second, and third quarters of 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number four, napansin ni Mr. Wamil na kulang-kulang ang mga dokumentong sinubmit. ng Office of the Vice President at ng DepEd for their liquidation of their respective confidential funds for the specified period. Number five. At dahil dito, si Mr. Wamil ay nag-issue ng audit and recommendations na tinatawag na Audit Observation Memorandum AOM dated September 14, 2023. and October 3, 2023, duly issued to the Office of the Vice President for the periods covering the fourth quarter of 2022 or the period December 21 to 31, 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number six, that Mr. Wamil also conducted the audit of the documents submitted by the OVP through its letters dated October 19, 2023, and November 30, 2023 in response to the aforementioned AOMs. Number seven, that in accordance with Mr. Wamil's audit and recommendations, nag-issue ng notice of suspension dated December 13, 2023 sa OVP.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number eight, In accordance with Mr. Wamil's audit and recommendation, an AOM dated February 1, 2024 was issued to the OVP for the periods covering the first, second quarters of 2023 and an AOM, Audit Observation Memorandum dated August 8, 2024. was issued to the Office of the Vice President for the period covering the third quarter of 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number nine, in accordance with Mr. Wamil's audit and recommendations, an audit observation memorandum number 2024-015, dated February 1, 2024, was duly issued to the DepEd. for the periods covering the first and second quarter of 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Likewise, Your Honor, we are offering the testimony of this witness to identify and authenticate documents, and likewise, lassie, to prove such other matters as are relevant and material to the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte. and relevant as well to the aforementioned purposes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Comment from the counsel for respondents on the offer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Subject to cross, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Subject to cross, counsel may proceed with her direct examination of the witness, Mr. Roderick C. Wamil, when she's ready. Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: you, Your Honor. With the permission of the presiding officer, honorable senator-judges. Magandang umaga, Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Magandang umaga po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Kumusta na po kayo ngayon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit anxious as of this moment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Please state your name again. Your name, your age, and occupation and other personal circumstances, Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: I am Roderick C. Wamil, 34 years old and currently an audit team leader of the Commission on Audit, Pasay City.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Before I ask you about your present occupation, give us a...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Educational background. What is your educational background, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ako po ay nagtapos ng Bachelor of Science in Accountancy from the Central Luzon State University at ng Juris Doctor degree from the Arellano University School of Law.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So you are both an auditor and a lawyer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ngayon, nagtrabaho ka sa COA?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: How long have you been working for the Commission on Audit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: I've been with the Commission on Audit for more than 11 years po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Eleven years. And what position in the COA do you presently hold?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: I presently hold the position po of attorney for of the Commission on Audit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ano yung attorney for?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: It is ano po, yung description of the position po na hinawakan ko. But currently po, I am an audit team leader po sa Commission on Audit Pasay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Before you were assigned to the Commission on Audit Pasay, what was your previous position with the COA?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Before my assignment to the Commission on Audit Pasay, I was previously assigned as a State Auditor of the Intelligence and Confidential Fund Audit Office of the COA.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Itong COA ICFAO?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: ICFAO?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Could you give us a background? Ano itong COA ICFAO?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang koa ikaw po ay yung office under the office of the chairperson in charge with the conduct of the post-audit po ng liquidation of the Confidential Fund and Intelligence Fund of the various government agencies which include the national government agencies, the government-owned or controlled corporations, and the local government units po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: For our understanding, para maintindihan namin ngayon, ano ang intelligence funds at ano ang confidential funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang intelligence funds po under the Joint Circular 2015-01 ay yung lump sum appropriation provided in the budget of the agency concerned with respect to their intelligence operations. Ano

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: naman ang confidential funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang confidential fund po based on the Joint Circular 2015-01 ay yung lump sum appropriation po ng concerned agency para sa kanilang confidential expenses.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At you earlier said, sinabi mo kanina na ang office ng ICPAO ang nag-audit ng national government agencies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Anong ibig sabihin ng nagko-conduct ng audit? Anong klaseng audit ang ginagawa ng COA-ICFAO?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang audit po na ginagawa ng COA-ICFAO ay compliance post-audit po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What do you mean by compliance post-audit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: When we say compliance post-audit po, we evaluate A certain subject matter which is covered by the audit with respect to a certain criteria po which is usually po yung applicable laws, rules, and regulations. And in case of the Confidential and Intelligence Fund, inevaluate po namin yung liquidation nung Confidential and Intelligence Fund based dun sa criteria na presented ng Joint Circular 2015-01. At pag sinabi naman pong post-audit, Ginagawa po namin yung audit after the fact of the disbursement. So ini-evaluate po namin kung yung disbursements ay properly supported with complete documents as required by the applicable rules and regulations and if yung disbursements po ay hindi illegal, hindi irregular, or hindi improper.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At sa pag-conduct na sinabi mong post-audit, ano ang basihan ng ginagamit natin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang ginagamit po namin sa ICWAW ay yung Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you tell us ano itong Joint Circular 2015-01?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang Joint Circular 2015-01 ay yung nagpuprovide po ng guidelines on the entitlement, the use, the release, the reporting po at yung audit ng confidential fund at ng intelligence fund of the various government agencies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: If I show you a document now entitled and this for appreciation of the Honorable Senate Impeachment Court is being flashed

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: on the screen with the permission of the Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel may do so and may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I'm showing to you now a document entitled the Joint Circular 2015 which for identification has been marked as Exhibit P-1-4 for the Prosecution.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Showing to you this document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: We have here, Your Honor, we're being assisted here by...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel may approach.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Our associate attorney, Mark Penny.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Likewise, assisting counsel for the respondent may approach.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: While we're waiting, counsel, attorney Capunan, would you like to identify this document as previously marked so that we can have it on the record and for the reference?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please. Mr. Witness, what relation does this joint circle have to the... Joint circular that you mentioned na basihan ng inyong audit, post-audit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ito po yung same joint circular po na basihan po ng aming audit sa ICPAO.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Bakit tinatawag ito na joint circular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Tinatawag po itong joint circular dahil ito po ay resulta ng joint efforts ng Commission on Audit ng Department of Interior and Local Government ng Department of the Budget and Management ng Department of the National Defense at ng Governance Commission for GOCCs. So

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: ito ay five government agencies, nama? And since when naging basihan ito ng mga post-audit ng national government agencies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Naging basihan po ito ng audit ng ICFAO sa Confidential Intelligence Funds ng various government agencies noong January 8, 2015, noong na-approve po ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, ikaw ay familiar sa joint circular na to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay, if I show you section 4.8, being flashed

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: on the screen, Your Honors, with the permission of the presiding justice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Sa section 4.8 na nanakikita natin sa screen, ano-ano, what kind of... Confidential expenses can be incurred using confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Under item 4.8 of the Joint Circular 2015-01, the confidential funds shall be used only for the following confidential expenses. Una po yung purchase of information necessary for the formulation and implementation of... Ano

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ano pa? Dahan-dahan natin. Unang-una? 4.8? Anong una?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang una po ay yung purchase of information necessary for the formulation and implementation of program activities and projects relevant to the national security and peace and order.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Being flashed

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: on the screen, Your Honor, is the pertinent provisions cited. Pangalawa, ano pa ang examples ng confidential funds or kung ano ang pwedeng paggamitan ng confidential funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Pangalawa po ay yung rental of transport vehicle related to confidential activities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Pangatlo po

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: yung rentals and the incidental expenses related to the maintenance of safe houses.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Pangapat po yung purchase or rental of supplies. Materials and equipment for confidential operations that cannot be done through regular procedures without compromising the information guided activity concerned.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Panglima po yung payment of rewards to informers who must not be employees of the concerned government agency subject to three conditions. First is yung approval by the head of the agency. Second, it must be supported with documents evidencing the success of the information gathering and or surveillance activities on account of the information given by the informer. Pangatlo, it must be directly related to the conduct of the specific confidential activities of authorized agencies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: For purposes of the records, Your Honor, the witness cited 4.8.1 up to 4.8.7 of the joint circular.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Anggang 4.8.5 pa lang po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Sorry. What else, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Pang-anim po is to uncover or prevent illegal activities that pose a clear and present danger to the agency personnel or property or other facilities and resources under the agency protection done in coordination with the appropriate law enforcement agencies. and last po, yung others that may be authorized by the GAA or other special laws.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: 4.8.1 up to 4.8.7 ang re-refer po ng ating witness of section 4.8 of the Joint Circular. Base rin sa Joint Circular na to, ano naman kung meron mga pwede, ano naman ang mga hindi pwede, yung mga bawal na confidential

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Under 4.11 po, may specific expenses po na enumerate na hindi pwedeng paggamitan ng confidential fund. Una po yung salaries, wages, overtime, additional compensation, allowance or other fringe benefits of officials and employees who are employed by the government in whatever capacity or elected officials except when authorized by law. Pangalawa, yung representation, consultancy fees or entertainment expenses, at pangatlo, yung construction or acquisition of buildings or housing structures.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: For the record, Your Honor, reference is made to 4.11, .1 up to .2, and as well as .3.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, sa pag-interpret, when you interpret, these regulations and these joint circular and sections that you mentioned, ano, what terms of compliance are you thinking about?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ito ba ay substantial compliance or strict compliance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Strict compliance po, madam.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Bakit, Mr. Witness? Why do you follow

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: strict compliance instead of substantial compliance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: We follow po strict compliance since what is involved po ay public funds. So dapat strict yung accounting and auditing rules to prevent yung misuse ng fund.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At nagsaga, and this is express, I'm sorry, this is expressly stated in the joint circular. What you said, strict compliance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now, nine years ka, you said, sa koa ikfaw. With

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: the permission of counsel. Mr. Witness, you mentioned, it is mentioned in the JMC that it should be strictly interpreted and you said it's in the JMC. Where?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Sa last paragraph po ng 1.0, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Last paragraph ng 1.0? So in the rationale?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. You may proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now, Mr. Witness, you mentioned earlier na nine years can be the koa ikpao. at merong combination that you audited, post-audited certain government agencies during

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: your term. What years were you, incidentally, with the COA-ICPAO?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: I was with the COA-ICPAO from September 2014 until February of 2024.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In this period of time, from 2014 to 2024, could you tell us How many vice-presidents have you audited?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang tanging nung time lang po ni vice-presidente Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But there were three? Who were the vice-presidents during this period?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang naging mga vice-presidente po since I assumed with ICPAO in 2014 ay sa ating vice-president Binay at sa ating vice-president Lenny Robredo at yung ating incumbent vice-president po na si Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So tatlong Vice President, Vice President Binay, Vice President Robreno, at Vice President Sara Duterte. Sino-sino sa kanila ang inaudit mo tungkol sa confidential funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang buhat po noong nag-assume ako noong 2014, tanging si Vice Presidente Sara Duterte lang po yung aking na-audit na may confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Bakit, Mr. Witness? Bakit Vice President Sara Duterte lang ang inaudit mo? ng confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Dahil po, since noong nag-asyon po ako noong 2014 sa ICPAU, wala pong naging appropriation for confidential funds si dating Vice President Binay at si dating Vice President Robredo. Tanging si Vice President Sara Duterte lang po yung nagkaroon ng appropriation for the confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And in the same period of time, 2014 to 2024, Kasama ba sa mga national agencies na minensyon mo ang Department of Education?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And during this period, 2014 to 2024, sino-sino ang mga sekretaris ng Department of Education?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Sa pagkakaalala ko po, ang mga naging DepEd sekretaris po ay dating sekretary Loistro, dating sekretary Briones at ang ating vicepresidente in her concurrent capacity as the DepEd secretary during that time po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At sino sa tatlong ito? Sino-sino sa mga sekretary ng DepEd ang inaudit mo for confidential funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Tanging si vicepresidente Sara Duterte lang po as the DepEd secretary.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Bakit, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Dahil siya lang po yung naging DepEd secretary na nagkaroon ng confidential funds ang DepEd.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And could you tell us how much was the confidential funds of the Vice President that you said you audited?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: May I clarify kung anong office po yung tinutukoy niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Office of the Vice President.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: So office of the Vice President po... Ang kanilang naging confidential fund ay from the fourth quarter of 2022 until third quarter of 2023 ay 125 million pesos per quarter. So ang total po nun ay 500 million pesos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Magkano naman ang confidential funds na inaudit mo sa DepEd, Department of Education?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang inaudit ko naman po sa Department of Education Since ang kanilang cash advances ay from the first quarter of 2023 until the third quarter of 2023, at meron silang 37.5 million pesos quarterly cash advances, so ang naging total punon ay 112.5 million pesos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Witness. Ngayon, you said that you conducted a post audit of both offices. Pag nagko-conduct ng post audit, ano ang nirequire na documents? para sa confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang nire-require po namin na documents ay yung mga requirements as provided under the Joint Circular 2015-01 o yung mga tinatawag na liquidation documents po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ano-ano ang mga liquidation documents na to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on the Joint Circular po, yung mga liquidation documents na yun ay yung kanilang liquidation reports, yung disbursement voucher na ginamit nila, land bank checks, yung obligation request, yung kanilang physical and financial plan, yung kanilang accomplishment reports po, and yung proof of submission nun to the Office of the President, the Senate President, and the Speaker of the House, yung certification of the accountable officers on the utilization of the confidential fund. yung designation po nung special dispersing officer kapag hindi si head of agency yung magiging dispersing officer, yung fidelity ban ng accountable officers at yung kanilang specimen signatures po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please, these liquidation documents submitted by the Office of the Vice President and the DepEd are among the stipulated documents of the counsel for the respondent, Your Honor. But for easy reference, may we also ask permission to flash them on the screen for the better appreciation of the senator-judges. And may

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I ask Attorney Peña to please show these documents to our witness for purposes of comparison.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel may approach the witness. Likewise, assisting counsel for the respondent, if they so wish. This is for the information of the Senator-Judges, given that the documents stipulated earlier were merely enumerated, so that the Senator-Judges may be appraised of the documents that have already been admitted to and stipulated to by both parties. Counsel may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Since stipulated, there's no need really to compare. I am showing now to you, and this is being flashed on the screen with the kind permission of residing judge, a copy of a physical financial plan approved on December 13, 2022, marked as Exhibit P-1-14 for the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And likewise, for the record on the part of the defense, marked as D-1-23-OVP. That's correct, Your Honor. Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Will the witness please respond?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Sa bottom portion, sa bottom portion,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: there appears a signature under the words. Meron pong signature sa words,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: approved by.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Anong ibig sabihin ng approved by?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang ibig sabihin po ng approved by ay in-approve po noong nakapirma yung contents noong physical and financial plan po based on that document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At sinabi mo, approved by ay in-approve kung sino man ang nakalagay na signature dyan. Kaninong signature naman ang nasa bottom portion ng ating Exhibit 1-14?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang kay Vice Presidente Sara Duterte po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Why are you familiar? Bakit mo kilala? Bakit mo alam ang signature ni Vice President Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Dahil among their submissions po ay yung kanilang specimen signatures at kasama po doon yung specimen signature po ni Vice President. At yung kanyang pirma po doon sa specimen signature submitted ay kaparehas po ng pirma niya dito sa physical and financial plan na ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Pinakita sa iyo ang isang physical financial plan which you said is

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: a faithful reproduction of the submissions. And this is now being shown on the screen. Ano? Ano-ano ang observations mo dito sa physical and financial plan approved on December 13, 2022?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Hindi po siya compliant to the Joint Circular dahil yung first column, which is the programs, activities, and projects, hindi po inindicate ni ng OBP yung kanilang specific confidential activities na kanilang paggagamitan ng confidential plan as required under item 4.2 of the Joint Circular.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Hindi ito specific according to you and according to 4.2 of the Joint Circular. Can you please enlighten us ano itong section 4.2 ng Joint Circular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Under item 4.2 po ng Joint Circular, all

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Request or allocations for CF must be supported with a physical and financial plan which must indicate the proposed amount allocated for each program and activity dahil ito po yung magiging basis for the disbursement ng kanilang confidential fund.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At yung mga sinabi mo, nakikita ba dyan sa dokumentong yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Wala. Based po on this subinter-physical and financial plan, hindi po nakikita rito yung kanilang specific confidential activities na kanilang pagbabasihan sa kanilang disbursement.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Apart from this, yung nakita mo sa column 1, ano pang ibang observations ang masasabi mo dito sa dokumentong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Since yung columns for the expected outcome as well as yung column for the physical target, mas match po yung specific confidential activities. So hindi rin po nakamatch or hindi rin compliant yung Colmes po, as mentioned.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At bakit? Why do you say na hindi compliant na rin to sa Joint Circular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Dahil po, since hindi naman inindicate po dito ni Office of the Vice President yung kanilang specific confidential activities, so hindi po na much based on the information as presented po sa document na ito, yung laman, yung expected outcome, at yung physical target doon sa kanilang specific confidential activities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And as you stated, what express provision of the Joint Circular does this violate?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: The item 4.2 po of the Joint Circular

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: 4.2 na pinakita natin sa screen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Our next document, Mr. Witness, which we shall show you, is now a certified true copy of Land Bank of the Philippines, check number 000244027. dated December 20, 2022, Exhibit P-1-11-A, common exhibit of both prosecution and defense.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Likewise being flashed on the screen, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, what is the significance? Ano ang significance ng check na pinapakita na ito in relation to your audit? of the Office of the Vice President's Confidential Funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang significance po ng cheque ay ito po yung proof na pwede na nalang i-withdraw yung kanilang cash advance.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Na pwedeng i-withdraw na yung cash advance. Ngayon naman, punta tayo sa another document. I will show you now a disbursement voucher. Dated December 20, 2022. Again, common exhibit. For the prosecution, this is exhibit P-1-10-A. For the period December 20, 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In the middle of this document,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In the middle of this document, there appears a signature under the words, quote, Certified Expense. cash advance necessary, lawful and incurred under my direct supervision and control. Anong ibig sabihin itong certified expense under my direct supervision?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honors, kindly we would like to object on that one. Your Honors, that calls for a conclusion of law.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I'm sorry, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: That will call for a conclusion of law on the part of the witness, Your Honor. They're asking for what that means for the witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Only insofar as how the witness interprets this provision given that he audited these documents and are part of the submission. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on this disbursement voucher po, sinertify po ni Vice President na yung kanilang cash advance ay kailangan na ayon sa batas at na-incorpo under her direct supervision.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And there is a signature here in this document. Whose signature is this, if you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: May I clarify kung anong signature po yung tinatukoy? Ah, yung sa...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Above the name, Sara Z. Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: That is the signature po of the Vice President, Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What else, if any, observation can you make as regards this document?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Under the particulars portion po, nakalagay na yung cash advance is for calendar year 2022 which is not compliant po with the joint circular since under the joint circular po, the disbursement voucher shall state the duration of the implementation of the project pero since this cash advance is for the fourth quarter 2022 so hindi po tama yung nakalagay dito na yung cash advance is for the calendar year 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At ano naman again? Ano ang violation nito sa Joint Circular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: May I refer po to the Joint Circular, Your Honor, for the specific provision?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Witness may refer to the Joint Circular previously, Mark.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: The specific provision po is the second sentence po ng item 6.1.5 of the Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Being flashed on the screen, Your Honor, Presiding Officer, with your kind permission.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may do so, Counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you read? For the record, 6.1.5.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: 6.1.5 of the Joint Circular. Cash advances shall be limited to the requirements for three months. The disbursement voucher shall clearly state the duration of implementation of the projects. If the implementation of the projects will extend to more than three months, additional amount may be granted only after the liquidation of the previous cash advance. If on the other hand, cash advances are drawn monthly, liquidation shall be done monthly. Cash advances shall be granted only upon the certification of the agency accountant stamped or printed on the disbursement voucher that previous cash advance for the same purpose, project, or activity given to the SDO requesting cash advance has been liquidated and proper accounting thereof was made in accordance with this joint circular.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ngayon naman, I will show you. Liquidation ang pinag-uusapan. I will show you a liquidation report dated January 10, 2023. Again, common exhibit. This is prosecution's exhibit P-1-9-A. A liquidation report dated January 10, 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In the middle of this document, by the bottom, there appears a signature under the words Certified Purpose of travel cash advance duly accomplished, Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And this certification...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, just to correct you, certified purpose of cash advance duly accomplished. There is no word travel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Do

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Do you confirm, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Certified purpose of travel cash advance...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Of cash advance. Of cash advance... Duly accomplished.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you for the correction, Your Honor. What does this mean in terms of your audit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: This means po na sinertify po ni Vice President na yung layunin ng cash advance ay kanilang na-accomplish.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And you said the Vice President? Whose signature is that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: That is the signature po of the Vice President, Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What is the significance of her signature to this document? If any.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang significance po nung kanyang firma dito ay kanya nga pong sinertify na yung purpose po nung kanilang cash advance from the confidential fund ay na-accomplish po ng agency.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And what are your observations? Ano ang mga observations mo, if any, sa dokumentong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Actually, it is one of the pro forma annexes po nung Joint Circular 2015-01. Siguro ang napansin ko lang dito ay yung period covered na December 21 to 31, 2022 since the cash advance was supposedly for the fourth quarter of the 2022 of the OBP. Pero other than that naman po, this document is compliant naman po with the requirement of the Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Again, para maintindihan namin, sabi mo ang na-observe mo ay yung period,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Anong period covered dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on this liquidation report po, ang period covered ay December 21 to 31, 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What is the significance? Bakit mo napansin itong period na to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Napansin ko lang naman po yun kasi yung kanilang cash advance based on the physical and financial plan po supposedly is for the A whole fourth quarter of 2022. Pero based on this document po, na-disperse lang siya from December 21 to 31, 2022 or around 11 days.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Sinabi mo, whole quarter of 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: September, no, November, October, sandali. Can you enlighten me anong quarter dapat siyon? October, November, December. ang sinasabi mong three quarters.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Three months po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Three months. Three months for the fourth quarter. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Three months for the fourth quarter, pero sabi mo ang ginastos na funds. Magkano ang ginastos na funds?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on the documents, po, submitted, 125 million pesos po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In these three quarters?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Three months?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on the document po, it was supposed to be spent for the fourth quarter of 2022, so three months po, supposedly. Bakit supposedly,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Dahil yun po yung supposed coverage nung kanilang cash advance for their confidential activities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At sinabi mo kanina, 11 days ito ginastos, tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on the document, yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now, I'm showing to you now. Another document which is an accomplishment report previously marked as prosecution's exhibit P-107-A-I. Again, stipulated document, common document with the defense.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What relation does this have?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: We request permission to have it flashed on the screen as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may do so, counsel. Clerk of court is so directed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Can you repeat the question, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No. Look at the screen and look at your document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What is the relationship of this accomplishment report that

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I am showing you in relation to those documents submitted by the Office of the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: This is the same accomplishment report po na sinubmit ni Office of the Vice President sa IGPOW.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. And there appears here in this document under the words, Approved by.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Whose signature is this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: It is the signature po of the Vice President, Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And the annotation, Approved by. In terms of your audit, what does this signify, if any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: It signifies po that the signatory or the Vice President approved the contents of this accomplishment report.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In relation to this particular document, what observations? Ano-ano ang napansin mo sa dokumentong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Napansin ko po na hindi po inenumerate ng Office of the Vice President yung kanilang specific confidential activities na kanilang ginawa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Kailangan bang inumerate yan? Yes, ma'am. Bakit, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Doon po kasi namin tinitignan sa audit ng ICFAO kung yung, kung sila ay, kung yung kanilang confidential expenses or activities ay compliant doon sa item 4.8 ng Joint Circular 2015-01. Para malaman po namin kung yung kanilang expenses ay among the allowable expenses as provided under the Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So what basis did you have? to determine if these were allowable expenses kung wala naman dokumento.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Katulad nga po nung sinabi ko, ang basis namin to determine if allowable expenses ay yung item 4.8 of the Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now, I'm now showing to you a certified copy of the Office of the Vice President certification dated January 10, 2022. Notarized on January 16, 2023. Prosecutions exhibit P-1.6-A. Likewise, a common exhibit with the defense previously stipulated. Being flashed on the screen with the kind permission of this court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel Mayduso.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Dito sa baba, may

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: pirma sa ilalim ng mga salitang attested.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Kaninong signature itong nakikita natin dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ito po ay signature ni Vice Presidente Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At anong ibig sabihin under your circular ng attested?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang ibig sabihin po ng attested ay kanyang kinoconfirm at bine-verify na yung contents nung certification na ito ay totoo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What other observations? Ano pa ang mga na-observe mo sa dokumentong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang napansin ko po dito yung date of execution ng certification, January 10, 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ano pa? January 10, 2022. Why is this significant?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Because it is supposedly the date of the execution ng certification pero yung kanilang cash advance ay for the fourth quarter of 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yung cash advance nila ay para sa anong period?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: For the fourth quarter po of 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Pero ang certification ay January 10, 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes po, based on this document po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And based on this document, when was it notarized?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: It was notarized po on January 16, 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: 2023, okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ano naman? In your observation, what provision of the Joint Circular does this certification violate?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Actually, ito po yung isa sa pro forma annexes ng Joint Circular. So, wala naman po kaming nakitang violation aside from the date of the execution.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So, yung sinasabi mo, nakikita dito, yung discrepancy ng mga dates.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on this document po, yes ma'am, may discrepancy yung dates.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Now, dahil dyan, what action did you take, if any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: After what po, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: After itong nakikita mong certification?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang naging action po namin, actually, yung naging audit namin is yung for the whole of the liquidation documents na sinamit ng OBP. Pero dito po, wala po kaming naging particular finding dito. Sinasabi ko nga po, it is one of the annexes po under the Joint Circular 2015-01 and they submitted naman po yung certification as required.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Earlier, nagpakita tayo ng certain liquidation documents, yung physical and financial plan, yung disbursement vouchers, yung land bank check, yung liquidation report. What actions did you take, if any, after your evaluation of these documents submitted by the Office of the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: After the evaluation po of... Those documents, since I noted that the documents are not compliant with the requirements of the Joint Circular 2015-01, I drafted po an audit observation memorandum which I submitted for review to my division chief.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you tell us, Mr. Witness, anong ibig sabihin ng audit observation memorandum or AOM?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang audit... Observation Memorandum po under the Joint Circular 2015-01 ay written notification to the accountable officers explaining to them or informing them the deficiencies po noted during the audit and requiring them to submit an explanation or to submit the documents being sought po dun sa AOM or both.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So, itong AOM was

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: on account of sinasabi mong discrepancies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Na-point out mo na dito sa Honorable Court now. If I show you a copy of this audit, observation, memorandum that you mentioned, please identify the same.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel for both parties may approach the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please again, this is a common exhibit. This is exhibit P-1-12-A, dated September 14. 2023 for the prosecution. Likewise, a defense exhibit, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: For the record, the witness is looking, well, is examining an audit observation memorandum dated September 14, 2023 covering the period December 21 to 31, 2022 or an 11-day period.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you tell us, Mr. Witness, what were your findings, if any? In relation to the audit of the Office of the Vice President's 4th Quarter Confidential Funds Liquidation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yung audit po ng Confidential Fund ng 4th Quarter of 2022 of the OBP disclosed that una, yung kanilang physical and financial plan ay hindi compliant dun sa requirements ng Joint Circular 2015-01. dahil hindi po inindicate nung OBP yung kanilang specific confidential activities na pagagabitan nila ng kanilang cash advance. So

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: una, hindi compliant and physical and financial plan ng Office of the Vice President. And

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: under the same item din po, yung kanilang accomplishment report ay hindi rin compliant dahil hindi rin po naka-indicate doon yung kanilang specific confidential activities na pinagamitan nila nung kanilang cash advance.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, for easy reference, we are flashing these particular portions of the document being referred to by the witness. Ano pa, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Pangalawa po, hindi po sinubmit ng Office of the Vice President yung kanilang documentary evidence of payments as required under item 4.12 of the Joint Circular 2015-01.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you remind us, ano-ano itong mga dokumento? na dapat sinubmit ng Office of the Vice President to liquidate for confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Under the Joint Circular 2015-01, yung documents po na dapat isubmit nung agencies concerned po ay una yung kanilang liquidation report as proof of the liquidation. Pangaliwa, yung kanilang mga documents na ginamit nila sa grant ng Cash Advance which include disbursement voucher, yung cheque, yung obligation request, yung physical and financial plan at yung

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Kasama din po yung accomplishment report nung agency, quarterly accomplishment report at yung proof of submission to the Office of the President, the Senate President and the Speaker of the House. Yung certification po nung accountable officer on the utilization of the confidential fund. Yung designation nung special disbursing officer in case the head of the agency ay hindi po yung SDO. Yung specimen signatures po nung signatories nung documents. yung fidelity bond, po, yung certification from the agency accountant na walang unliquidated cash advances, yung SDO. At

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: sinabi mo earlier, So

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: these

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: are the documentary evidence required. Sinabi mo earlier in your testimony that there were discrepancies and insufficiencies in this document submitted.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.text: Pursuant to the July 20, 2026 ruling of the Presiding Officer, the BIR, Bureau of Internal Revenue, the Anti-Money Laundering Council, BDO Unibank, Philippine Savings Bank, PS Bank, Metropolitan Bank and Trust Company, Security Bank, Land Bank of the Philippines, and the Bank of the Philippine Islands, through their representatives, submitted. The same ruling applies for the other banks and government agencies and offices.
